programs.title: Taken
programs.desc: An American teenager travelling through Europe is abducted by a gang of sex traffickers. However, what the kidnappers do not realise is that the girl's father is a former CIA agent, who employs all his old skills as he searches for the criminals and tries to rescue his daughter. Thriller, starring Liam Neeson, Famke Janssen and Maggie Grace.

programs.title: Ghost Rider
programs.desc: Motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sells his soul to diabolical Mephistopheles to save the life of his father. His bargain dooms him to pass each night as Ghost Rider, a demonic skeletal biker bound to take evil souls to Hell. However, conflict between Mephistopheles and his son offers Johnny the chance to win back his humanity. Fantasy thriller based on the comic-book, starring Nicolas Cage, Eva Mendes and Wes Bentley.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Dusty and Lupe pedal their way to an auction in Fullerton, but end up needing the truck. Darrell pins his hopes on a small locker for which he overpaid. Rene makes the most of the honeymoon unit.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Is Rick crazy enough to trade $90K in gold for a classic 1932 Roadster? Or a guitar for an extremely rare 18th century double-barrel coaching gun?

programs.title: Frozen Gold
programs.desc: In the final week of the season, the team are still battling the remnants of Hurricane Larry, but they are determined to risk everything to continue mining; Ray embarks on one last expedition that could bring them a fortune at last.

programs.title: Fat Pizza: Back In Business
programs.desc: Pauly Falzoni becomes the victim of fake news and must deal with the backlash.
